scope: synthetic method extension, not real movement, no McKee data or 2h holdout; 3/31/3 unchanged
state: node id with fixed integer time, edges strictly advance time; nonnegative integer distance/environment/barrier, hard-blocked edges excluded; no implicit waiting or graph interpolation
estimand: single source-to-target directed path visiting ordered checkpoint vertex IDs; different paths permitted between worlds, never splice worlds; population-level independent reachability is a different estimand
coordinates: maximum exact rational edge distance/duration V
frontiers: within world: all Pareto-minimal path maxima; possible: ParetoMin(union of world frontiers); robust feasible: ParetoMin(componentwise max over one path vector per world); empty world => empty robust; exact continuous nonnegative relaxation domain conditional on finite graph/time states, no continuous landscape certificate

stress.generator: per system per world iterate i<j in lexical order; random.Random seed; if rng.random()<.45 draw distance, env, barrier via randint then hard via rng.random()<.15; integer node ids = times
stress.oracle: independent DFS enumerate complete source-target paths, filter checkpoint membership in order and hard blocks; exact fractions; brute pairwise maxima for robust frontier
stress.success: zero DP/DFS disagreements across all worlds and both aggregate frontiers; report counts for unreachable, possible-but-not-robust, independent checkpoint reachability false, robust frontier differs, multiobjective tradeoffs; no expected effect-size thresholds

cases: checkpoint_alias: source0,target4,checkpoint2; edges 0->2 and 0->4 only; both individually reachable but no path visits 2 then 4
world_quantifier: source0,target4; world A edges 0->1->4, world B edges 0->2->4; use tradeoff route values separately; robust frontier (3,3,2,1) has distinct paths; empty world makes robust empty
hard_block: direct 0->4 hard blocked; no feasible relaxation
stop: no production API, no new empirical score; retain hard STOP and draft review; no post-score change to frozen cases
